description: MAINE — The Hannah Pingree for Governor campaign announced today that it has raised more than $3 million dollars since entering the race, including over $900,000 during this truncated 42-day fundraising period. The campaign again has set a new record for the most funds any Democrat has raised in a Maine gubernatorial race during this reporting period and has $921,000 cash on hand as of today.
